items.headline: Tim Tebow explains why LSU, Alabama are peaking at the right time
items.description: Tebow joins The Paul Finebaum Show to break down how the steady play of No. 14 LSU and No. 5 Alabama sets up a competitive matchup.

items.headline: Matt Barrie on massive Week 10: 'This is the tipping point weekend'
items.description: Barrie says the the conclusion of Saturday's slate will flip the entire football landscape on its axis due to the amount of ranked, decisive games as the CFP approaches.

items.headline: Fowler says CFP committee undervalued LSU, previews matchup with Bama
items.description: Chris Fowler joins The Paul Finebaum Show to discuss what the Crimson Tide needs to do to get a win on the road at LSU who is looking to make a statement.

items.headline: Chris Doering expects five SEC teams to compete in 2026 CFP
items.description: SEC This Morning's Doering and Peter Burns use historical data and the Allstate Playoff Predictor to discuss the SEC presence in this year's College Football Playoffs.

items.headline: Peter Burns on Alabama at No. 5: 'Literally relax'
items.description: With the first College Football Playoff rankings out, SEC This Morning's Peter Burns says there is no need to overreact to No. 5 Alabama because the rankings will continue to change each week.

items.headline: No. 13 Tennessee, No. 18 Mizzou lead the Peter Power Rankings list
items.description: SEC Network's Peter Burns lists Week 10's top-5 SEC teams that need a win, adding extra emphasis on No. 21 South Carolina and the Vols before naming Missouri as most dire.
